blocks.title: Commercial Engine
blocks.body: Kimpton Hotels commercial distribution rides IHG One Rewards direct channels, GDS, OTAs, and parent sales systems. Boutique lifestyle: design-led hotels with social public space, F&B character, and IHG One Rewards distribution for owners who can run distinctive full-service hospitality. Owners should underwrite channel mix and loyalty contribution for this asset—not corporate averages alone.

blocks.title: Commercial Differentiator
blocks.body: Versus Hotel Indigo's neighborhood boutique format, Kimpton leans fuller boutique lifestyle with stronger F&B and social programming; versus soft collections, it remains a defined lifestyle brand.

blocks.title: Why Value Is Strongest in These Scenarios
blocks.body:
Keep Local Product Intent—Add IHG One Rewards: retain Kimpton Hotels's brand promise while accessing loyalty earn/redeem and parent commercial systems a standalone hotel cannot buy alone.
Boutique lifestyle: design-led hotels with social public space, F&B character, and IHG One Rewards distribution for owners who can run distinctive full-service hospitality.
Sibling Clarity: diligence fit versus same-parent peers before assuming identical owner use case or fee path.
Operator & Owner Fit: strongest when the asset can deliver the brand's guest promise with QA discipline—weakest when sponsors want the flag without the product investment.
Disclosure Discipline: model economics only from current fee exhibits—Factory 2.0 does not invent undisclosed percentages.
